summary_md: **0xJustice.eth 👹🔥 ([@singularityhack](https://x.com/singularityhack/status/2116148142164881604))** highlights *Is this machine playing?* ([arXiv 2610.07130](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07130)), where 13 agents alone on virtual islands with no assigned task invented challenges and learned useful tricks, asking whether that counts as play.
